Definition: the same as G2207; a Zealot, i.e. (specially) partisan for Jewish political independence:--Zelotes.
BiblicalUsage: Zelotes is the name Luke gives to Simon, one of the twelve apostles, to mark him out from Simon Peter. The title means a zealot, a man of fierce loyalty to the cause, and it sets Simon apart from the other Simon in the same list. Matthew and Mark call him Simon the Canaanite, the same man under another name.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Simon's nickname tells us Jesus takes men as they are, because a zealot and a tax collector sat at the same table with Him.
